title: Eventual detection of zero in affine etale cohomology
statement: Let $I$ be a nonempty directed preordered set and let $D:I^{\mathrm{op}}\to\mathrm{Sch}$ be an inverse diagram of affine quasi-compact quasi-separated schemes [def-pc-scheme, def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions] with affine transition morphisms. Let $(X,(f_i))$ be a limit cone [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit]. For each $i$, let $F_i$ be an abelian sheaf on $(D_i)_{\acute{e}t}$ [def-weil-pbc-abelian-etale-sheaves], with maps $\varphi_f:D(f^{\mathrm{op}})^{-1}F_i\to F_j$ for $f:i\to j$ [def-weil-pbc-inverse-image] satisfying the canonical inverse-image identity and composition laws. Let $G:I\to\operatorname{Ab}(X_{\acute{e}t})$ be identified objectwise with $f_i^{-1}F_i$ by isomorphisms, its arrows being inverse-image composition followed by pullback of $\varphi_f$. Let $L$ be a colimit cocone on $G$, with coprojections $\iota_i$. Fix $p\ge0$. Write $eG_i:G_i\cong f_i^{-1}F_i$ for the specified isomorphisms. For every $i\in I$ and $x\in H^p(D_i,F_i)$ whose image $H^p(\iota_i\circ eG_i^{-1})(f_i^*x)$ is zero in $H^p(X,L)$, there exist $j\in I$ and $f:i\to j$ such that $H^p(\varphi_f)(D(f^{\mathrm{op}})^*x)=0$. This asserts eventual detection of zero only, with no assertion that all limit classes descend.

source.place: Theorem 09YQ via Lemmas 0EYL, 04HR and 09YP; finite-stage kernel half, with dimension shifting as in Tag 0739.

proof.text: An inverse limit of affine stages with affine transition maps is affine. Present its affine etale site by the strictified filtered system supplied by the affine etale site colimit theorem.

Restrict sheaves to the affine etale sites. On an affine etale object the two direct images are evaluation on its base change, so the right adjoints agree under the restriction equivalences. Uniqueness of left adjoints compatible with adjunction units gives the inverse-image comparisons. Uniqueness for the composite unit gives their coherence. Transport the coefficient maps, G, L, and its legs; equivalences preserve their colimit.

Fix a stage and pass to its cofinal tail. Apply site cohomology continuity at its affine final object, whose base changes are the final objects of the later sites and the limit site. Compute object and global cohomology by the same injective resolutions. The restriction equivalences identify them naturally. Unit compatibility from the preceding step identifies the pullback maps, hence the displayed coefficient transition and comparison formulas specify exactly the transported maps. Enlarging the strict system to the coefficient universe, if needed, does not change its colimit, by the equivalences given by universe lifts. Use only the eventual-zero half of the site theorem, starting at i and x; unit compatibility identifies the zero comparison image and the transition which kills x.
The tail is cofinal. Its indices are later indices of I, so its class representatives and killing transitions yield exactly the existential conclusion on I.
